alex-sales: Quick one 1) train strike caused me to reroute and I ended up overnighting in Lyon. I paid ?89.50 for a last-minute hotel and a ?14 taxi to the station. Corporate Amex covered my outbound Eurostar originally but the reroute was on my card. I uploaded the hotel folio but it's missing an itemized breakdown (just a single line "Total ?89.50"). Need to be reimbursed.

maria-finance: Sorry about the disruption! Can you confirm business purpose and attendees? Also note whether the original corporate charge was refunded or still pending. We need proof of corp auth + personal posted amount.

alex-sales: Business purpose: customer emergency onsite (ACME Corp) - travel diverted due to strike, solo traveler. Original corp Amex charge for Eurostar is still posted; hotel is personal. I attached hotel folio PDF and my bank screenshot showing posted ?89.50.

ryan-travel: For strike reroutes we allow reasonable last-minute lodging. Two quick asks: 1) please include the train ticket/booking with timestamp showing the strike (screenshot of Eurostar email or national rail alert is ok), 2) if you had to buy a new train ticket also attach that. We'll reimburse posted amounts.

alex-sales: Uploaded Eurostar delay email (screenshot) and the replacement SNCF ticket purchase (card ending 1122) - ?42.30. That one I already submitted earlier as "Transport" but got flagged because the hotel receipt missing itemization blocked the lodging reimbursement.

maria-finance: ExpenseBot: parsed attachments and flagged: hotel folio lacks line-level VAT/room vs taxes split. For EU expenses we prefer folio with VAT or a folio stating "Invoice". If not available, we'll reimburse gross but mark VAT as non-reclaimable. Also missing: manager approval for out-of-policy lodging rate (policy max Lyon per-diem ?85/night). Hotel is slightly over.

diane-ops: Happy to approve the exception - this was forced by the strike. Alex, can you add a short manager note: "Emergency reroute due to national rail strike; Diane O approves."

alex-sales: Added manager note in the Ramp submission and uploaded Diane's Slack approval screenshot.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Flag resolved: manager approval present. Still recommended: request an itemized folio from the hotel showing VAT ID. If unavailable, finance will code as non-reclaimable VAT (GL 6102 - Lodging, tag: VAT non-reclaimable).

maria-finance: Next steps: 1) we'll reimburse ?89.50 + ?14 taxi + ?42.30 replacement ticket converted to USD using posted bank rates; 2) code hotel to GL 6102 and mark VAT non-reclaimable; 3) if you can obtain a supplier invoice later, send it and we'll attempt reclaim. Reimbursement timeline ~5-7 business days after approval.

alex-sales: Thanks team - submitted and attached everything. Appreciate the quick approval.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder - submit within 30 days to avoid additional review.
